Ukraine conflict: Disputed city control and alleged biological threats

Reports indicate conflicting claims regarding the capture of the eastern Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka, with Ukraine denying Russian assertions of control. Simultaneously, Ukraine has accused Russia of creating an anthrax risk by allegedly burying a "bioweapon" in occupied territory. These developments occur amidst broader concerns about the ongoing conflict and potential escalation, with Poland's Prime Minister warning of critical months ahead due to the Russian threat.
